name: hson-language
description: Syntax highlighting and authoritative diagnostics for HSON files and supported HSON tagged templates.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Syntax tooling works in Restricted Mode. Trusted Schema diagnostics execute project code only with Workspace Trust and explicit enablement.

scripts.test: npm run test:grammar && npm run test:unit
scripts.package:vsix: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --out hson-language.vsix

hson.trustedSchemaDiagnostics.enabled.description: Explicitly allow trusted project Schema execution. Also requires Workspace Trust. Not a sandbox.

hson.trustedSchemaDiagnostics.module.description: Trusted Schema registration module path relative to the workspace folder. Prefer a Schema-only module, not the application entrypoint.

hson.trustedSchemaDiagnostics.hsonModule.description: Path to the project's hson.js facade (same runtime instance as its private D1 entry).

hson.trustedSchemaDiagnostics.runtimeEnt.description: Optional private D1 Node entry path; defaults beside hson.js under internal/trusted-schema-diagnostics.

hson.trustedSchemaDiagnostics.execArgv.description: Explicit trusted Node loader arguments, if required by the configured project runtime.
